claims.claim: The PromptArena CLI is built with a Go toolchain.
The template repo is cloned at ../promptkit-templates (example path).
A template lives in a new directory under the template repo, named after the template.
template.yaml uses apiVersion promptkit.altairalabs.ai/v1alpha1.
template.yaml uses kind: Template.
template.yaml has a spec.files field.
template.yaml accepts a variables field.
Each entry in spec.files accepts a source field that points to a separate file.
Template loading sets BaseDir.
A `source` path resolves relative to the directory of the `template.yaml` being rendered.
index.yaml takes entries under spec.entries.
Each index entry has the fields name, version, description and source.
The source value is a path of the form <template-name>/template.yaml relative to the index.
Template versions are semver-like and the reader increments them when templates change.
A local index path (--index) avoids fetching from GitHub.
promptarena templates list accepts --index.
promptarena templates fetch accepts --index, --template and --version.
promptarena templates fetch fills the local cache.
promptarena templates render accepts --index, --template, --version, --values and --out.
The --values flag takes a YAML file of variable values.
promptarena templates repo add accepts --name and --url.
A repo added with a name can be referenced as <name>/<template>, for example local/your-template.
GOCACHE=.cache/go-build go test ./arena/templates ./arena/cmd/promptarena runs the template tests.
The Go tests exercise template loading, repo resolution and CLI flows.
A template directory holds a README.md that describes the generated files.
A template directory holds a values.example.yaml that shows the expected variables.
templates render succeeds for a correct template.
Provider names openai, claude, gemini and mock are the current provider names.
Template changes are submitted as a PR against promptkit-templates.
templates render --template without --version renders the latest version the index lists, which must be cached, and needs a readable index
fetch caches template.yaml and every file a relative source names; a source that escapes the template directory is rejected
fetch and render accept a path-form --index; a path index is cached under a key derived from its absolute path
